artifact: MO independent ML five-card peer and scoped questions
scope: Read-only peer of clean_gap_review_ml_integrated.json and ml_root_five_proposition_recovery.json; exact GDT712/GDT713 report and static audit rows only. No registry mutation, raw TSV, images, experiments, or meaning admission.
material_checks: All five recovered propositions retain unconfirmed/source-bound status and scientific_test_ready=false.
The corrected oram/otam cards preserve the older Ansatz-bearing claims as historical cases while separating later lexical core from local rendering; they must not be overwritten or collapsed.
The CKH/CPH card explicitly keeps CPH distinct from CKH; no AL component export, free E_ATTR/O_PREP word, medicine identity, or six confirmed meanings is asserted.

The ten AL applications and six CKH/CPH applications are static source-model rows. They are valid provenance applications, but page counts/static rows do not independently validate meaning or provide a new folio selector.

evidence.quote: Die wichtigste neue Defaultregel lautet `AL -> Material I` und, nur in den zugelassenen DAL-Schwestern, `DAL -> abgemessenes Material I`. Dadurch verschwinden `Rohstoffklasse`, `Rohdroge`, `Drogenrohstoff`, erfundene Dosis- und Mengenkoepfe, ohne eine konkrete Zutat einzusetzen.

Die einzige `cheop`-Position ist nach beiden Alternativlesern die linke Haelfte von `cheop ol`. V85 markiert deshalb f115r.1#5 als `G683_CHEOP_OL LEFT`; das bereits gebundene `ol#2` bleibt RIGHT. Der lokale Span rendert einmal als `bis zur Mittelstufe getrockneter Pulverstoff`, beide Komponenten sind nicht global exportierbar.

Die sechs CKH/CPH-Ganzformen tragen jetzt den gelernten Familienkopf `Mischung`, nie `Arznei`. Sichtbare Trocken-/Feucht- und Grund-/Anfangsfelder bleiben erhalten. E_ATTR und O_PREP bleiben Strukturmetadaten; sie werden nicht zu freien deutschen Woertern. Wo der O-Rahmen lokal praktisch lesbar ist, steht `Ansatz` nur in der Fundstellenrealisierung.

Bei den Massformen wird `oram` zu `Maßportion` verdichtet; der unbelegte Ansatzkopf und der lexikalisierte Artikel verschwinden aus dem Wortkern. `otam` traegt als Kern `kalt; Maß I` und rendert an beiden benachbarten Stellen weiter konkret als `ein Maß kalten Ansatzes`. Inhalt und historische Einheit bleiben offene Slots, nicht erfundene Substantive.

prospective_questions.question: Does the bounded AL/DAL family default remain stable across admitted AL forms while quality/stage fields vary, or does AL acquire a portable material-class/ingredient or unit role outside the admitted family?
prospective_questions.rivals: family-intersection Material I versus free AL/D lexical/component export and named-material/unit readings.
prospective_questions.changed_observation: A predeclared occurrence set with independently coded family membership, state/stage, and any material/unit cue could change the family-default decision; page-count increase or fluent translation cannot.
prospective_questions.limits: DAL measurement and AL material core remain separate; no free A/L decomposition is assumed.

prospective_questions.question: Do the six named CKH/CPH whole forms support one bounded Mischung family head with dry/wet and stage metadata, or does the source support an Arznei/other-head split?
prospective_questions.rivals: Mischung family head versus Arznei/Arzneizubereitung or action-of-mixing readings.
prospective_questions.changed_observation: Matched whole forms with independently coded CKH versus CPH shell, E_ATTR/O_PREP status, and stage/state can discriminate the family model; CPH must remain a separate construction and no component is exported as a word.
prospective_questions.limits: Static applications are provenance, not independent confirmation; no requirement to identify medicine or translate E_ATTR.

prospective_questions.question: Is the cheop+ol left/right span a local whole construction whose powder/drying realization is context-bound, or does cheop carry that realization independently?
prospective_questions.rivals: two-group local span versus cheop-alone portable powder/drying core.
prospective_questions.changed_observation: A predeclared set of independently segmented cheop and cheop-ol spans with local role/rendering annotations could alter the scope; agreement of alternate readers or same-page repetition cannot confirm the lexical meaning.
prospective_questions.limits: Preserve free ol#1 and bound ol#2 separately; span segmentation is testable independently of substance identity.

prospective_questions.question: Can core content, local rendering, internal segmentation, and unit/measure behavior be separated for oram and otam?
prospective_questions.rivals: oram OR+AM Maßportion versus O+R+AM or preparation-head readings; otam kalt;Maß I core versus learned-unit/cold-preparation rival.
